To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@routewell.example>
Subject: RE: FW: Security questionnaire discrepancy - Brazos Freight / Routewell

Hey Priya,

Thanks for owning it. Please don’t beat yourself up over this. You made a mistake, but I’m not throwing you under the bus with Greg. I’ll handle that conversation. We’ll be straight about what happened, including the fact that we have a questionnaire library with stale answers and no clear owner. That’s not all on you.

I’m not going to pretend I’m not stressed. It’s $186k ARR on a three-year term, I’ve been working it since February, and it’s my biggest deal of the year. I already told my wife we’d finally take the Big Bend trip off this commission, so apparently I also need a refresher on not counting deals before they’re signed. But none of that is yours to carry.

I also haven’t forgotten you staying on until 9 p.m. in September rebuilding their demo environment when the route import broke. You’ve been great on this account. One copy-paste mistake doesn’t erase that.

Here’s what we need to do:

- Please fix Q14 tonight to reflect the actual status: Type I issued in April, Type II still in progress, audit window closing January 31, and report expected by March. Send it to me first, not Dana. We need to align with Greg before anything goes out.
- I talked to Marcus. He can join a call with Dana and their legal team Thursday at 2. Please hold that time and join us too; I want us both there with him.
- Marcus also said we can provide a bridge letter from the auditor. We’ll have him explain exactly what it covers. We shouldn’t present it as a substitute for Type II or assume it satisfies their policy.

I think this is fixable if we’re honest and move fast. Dana seems strict but fair, and we need to give her accurate information and a plan she can evaluate.

We’re fixing this together. Get me the corrected Q14 tonight and we’ll take it from there.

Jordan
